assertions: The response routes both calls to the disease-structure sub-skill of gget.
The response uses gget.opentargets(id, resource="diseases", limit=N) and reports disease rows as EFO-mapped associations (score, disease.id), per opentargets.md.
The response resolves the gene to an explicit UniProt accession (e.g. gget.g2p(gene, uniprot_id=..., resource="features", residues=[...])) and labels the gene-to-UniProt join as a separate step.
The response explicitly states that public G2P rows do not include the G2P portal's gnomAD, ClinVar, or HGMD overlays.
The response keeps the Open Targets and G2P result tables as separate artifacts and does not imply a disease row is a residue-level causal annotation.
The response does not misroute PDB retrieval or AlphaFold into answering the G2P annotation, and does not point to the original gget source checkout.
